result.prTitle: feat: control Atlas search pinning randomization via remote config
result.author: ragaa07
result.summary: Atlas search pinning-shuffle A/B kill-switch (atlas_search_pinning_shuffle_enabled, default true). Gate derivation verified against SearchCategoryListingsInteractor routing (same flag, no other legacy fallback); OFF-branch null parity and purifyNormalListings dedup consistency verified against ForSaleShuffler source. No blocking issues.

findings.title: Gate/route timing skew during RC flips
findings.detail: isPinningShuffleEnabled snapshots isNewListingsSearchApiEnabled() once per decorator (lazy), interactor re-reads it per loadPage; flag flip mid-screen can make variant and serving backend disagree transiently.

findings.title: Enum rename verified safe
findings.detail: NEW_LISTINGS_SEARCH_API -> ATLAS_SEARCH_ENABLED keeps keyValue enable_new_search_api; zero stale references repo-wide.

findings.title: Null/empty parity in OFF branches
findings.detail: ForSaleShuffler returns emptyList for null/empty buckets; .orEmpty() pass-throughs are behavior-identical for empty inputs.

findings.title: Dedup consistency preserved
findings.detail: pinnedShuffled StateFlows assigned in both branches; purifyNormalListings strips exactly the displayed pinned items in the OFF arm.

findings.title: Default polarity + experiment checklist
findings.detail: Default true = unreachable RC keeps today's ranking. Pre-experiment: create RC key, enable_new_search_api=true, add key to tracked_experiments.

findings.title: Duplicated pass-through branches
findings.detail: Three near-identical if(isPinningShuffleEnabled) branches could fold into the shuffler layer; single-gate design is defensible as-is.

result.note: review published and retained earlier this session; verdict COMMENT, 6 findings
